# vue-wechat-auth-third-party

> 标签: JavaScript

## 简介

基于vue开发的微信单页应用授权插件,适用于代开微信小程序授权

## 官网

- 官网：https://github.com/FishSunny/vue-wechat-auth-third-party#readme
- 源码仓库：git+https://github.com/FishSunny/vue-wechat-auth-third-party.git
- npm 页面：https://www.npmjs.com/package/vue-wechat-auth-third-party

- 当前版本：1.0.1

- 1.0.0
- 1.0.1

- npm 安装：`npm install vue-wechat-auth-third-party`
- npm registry：https://registry.npmjs.org/vue-wechat-auth-third-party
- Node 要求：>= 6.0.0
